title: Cloud export and retention policy
content: Workspace owners on all Nimbus Cloud plans can request a standard workspace export from Settings > Data. The export includes records and attachments created in the workspace. Exports are prepared asynchronously; the interface shows status when the file is ready. Support must not promise a completion time. Export links expire after 7 days. Data residency region does not change this process. A deleted workspace cannot be exported through self-service; route such requests to a data specialist for review.
